description:
[Wallet Oracle] Is this address on the US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions list? Exact match against every digital-currency address OFAC publishes (EVM, Tron, Bitcoin and others), with the sanctioned entity, program, and the list's publish date - Free. Is this address on the US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions list? Exact match against every digital-currency address OFAC publishes (EVM, Tron, Bitcoin and others), with the sanctioned entity, program, and the list's publish date. Chain-agnostic.

**Example:** `/v1/sanctions-check?address=0x8589427373D6D84E98730D7795D8f6f8731FDA16`

Use when you need a free yes/no on whether an address is on the OFAC SDN sanctions list. Not for broader counterparty risk (use wallet_check).

Behavior: read-only and free; no key or payment needed.

address.description: Required. Any wallet address (0x EVM, Tron T..., Bitcoin, Solana, ...).

name: wallet_sanctions_check
